text: In response to community input from the local Business Improvement Area and key stakeholders, I am requesting naming the laneway north of Eglinton Avenue West, extending west from Dufferin Street, as "Fairbank Village Lane" to: - recognize and commemorate the rich history of the Village of Fairbank; - reaffirm neighbourhood (or community) identity and roots amidst the rapid changes in the community catalyzed by the arrival of the Eglinton LRT; and - correspond and keep consistency with the newly named Fairbank LRT Station at Dufferin and Eglinton.

North York Community Council: 1. Requested the Manager, Land and Property Surveys to investigate and report to the next meeting of North York Community Council on the suitability of naming the public street located north of Eglinton Avenue West and extending west from Dufferin St as "Fairbank Village Lane".
